senses.gloss: m. (κεφάλωτον, sub. πράσον) leek with a head (porrum capitatum), porret.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Pesachim 2">Tosef. Pes. II (III), 20</cite> they left a corner (<cite ref="Q00006"><he>פֵּאָה</he></cite>) only <he>ללפת ולק׳</he> (ed. Zuck. <he>ולקפליטאות</he>) of turnips and porret; <cite ref="Pesachim 56b">Pes. 56ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 6:2:4">Y. Ber. VI, 10ᶜ</cite> top; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="S01756"><he>קַפְלוֹטוֹת</he></cite>, <he>קַפְלוֹטָאוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 2:1:20">Y. Ter. II, 41ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>ראשי ק׳</he> heads of leeks.

<cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 6:9">Ned. VI, 9</cite> (<cite ref="Nedarim 53a:6">53ᵃ</cite>) <cite ref="S01756"><he>קפלטות</he></cite> Mish. (Y. a. Bab. ed. <he>קפלו׳</he>). Tosef. Pes. l. c. <he>קפליטאות</he> (corr. acc.).
